releases.name: Version 1.4.0
releases.body:
Expanded the HUD with new informations :
-Apoapsis : Highest point in the ship orbit
-Periapsis : Lowest point in the ship orbit
releases.bodyZh:
扩展了HUD，添加了新的信息：
-远拱点：飞船轨道的最高点
-近拱点：飞船轨道的最低点

releases.name: Version 1.3.0
releases.body:
Expanded the HUD with new informations :
-Compass : display the ship rotation in relation to the north pole

-Altimeter : display the altimer near the ship landing cam onto the screen

-Allowed the Flight Path Vectors to work while no planet has been targeted

-The HUD can now be disabled if some of the ship component get damaged.
releases.bodyZh:
扩展了HUD，增加了新的信息：
-指南针：显示飞船相对于北极的旋转方向
-高度计：在屏幕上显示靠近飞船着陆摄像头的海拔计
-允许飞行路径向量在没有锁定星球时工作
-如果飞船某些部件受损，现在可以禁用HUD

releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
Added a new HUD that can show multiple new informations :
- Speed parallel to the target surface
- Closure rate to the target
- True Speed (parallel speed + closure rate)
- Acceleration of the ship in G or m/s
- Speed required to orbit the target

Added new options to hide elements of the mod :
- Trajectory markers
- Trajectory console
- new HUD

Fixed a bug where the cockpit could get closed off by a leftover collision
releases.bodyZh:
新增了一个可以显示多种新信息的HUD：
- 目标表面平行速度
- 目标闭合速率
- 真实速度（平行速度+闭合速率）
- 船只加速度（G或m/s）
- 环绕目标所需速度

新增了隐藏模组元素的选项：
- 轨迹标记
- 轨迹控制台
- 新HUD

修复了一个驾驶舱可能因残留碰撞而关闭的问题
